statement: The pinned SDL Linux joystick implementation tracks evdev device appearance and removal using udev, inotify or polling, while the reviewed SDL Xbox One HIDAPI implementation handles per-device controllers and contains no xone wireless receiver association lifecycle. Separate xone-created gamepad evdev nodes are a viable SDL-facing consumer surface in source; SDL backend selection and live hotplug behavior were not tested.

applicability.revision: Out-of-tree xone f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280; Linux v7.3 or pinned SDL where cited
applicability.scope: SDL_sysjoystick.c:383-610, 709-758, 947-1068; SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:364-396, 1942-2053; xone driver/gamepad.c:265-311. SDL revisions are independently pinned; no runtime test.
